name: Git
description: The whole git CLI through Total Recall: sign-in from the auth store, guarded commits and pushes, undo, fleet state, and the intent behind every change.
author: Total Recall

tasks: Commit or push with identity, secret and rule checks
Sign git in through the auth store
Check repository state across the mesh
Keep the git CLI current on every node

owned_commands.use: total-recall git <same git command and arguments>

tasks.intent: Check and update the git CLI

subcommands.name: audit
subcommands.description: Summarise branch, worktree, upstream and stash state (--json for machine output)

subcommands.name: diff
subcommands.description: Read a stat or patch for unstaged, staged or base-relative changes

subcommands.name: commit
subcommands.description: Check identity, conflicts, HEAD, secrets and repository rules, then run git's own commit with your arguments

subcommands.name: push
subcommands.description: Check outgoing commits for secrets and rules, turn --force into --force-with-lease, then run git's own push

subcommands.name: credential-helper
subcommands.description: Git credential helper: give git the mapped auth-store credential (get); store and erase do nothing

subcommands.name: auth
subcommands.description: Sign-in: status (live check, no secret shown), map <host> <KEY>, setup (helper entries for this machine)

subcommands.name: cli
subcommands.description: Git CLI metadata (version, path, install source, upstream, release notes); --all-nodes for the mesh; cli update updates git through its installer

subcommands.name: undo
subcommands.description: Restore refs, index and files from the snapshot taken before a destructive git command; --list shows snapshots

subcommands.name: fleet
subcommands.description: Dirty, unpushed, behind, diverged, stale stashes and abandoned worktrees across registered repositories; --all-nodes for the mesh

subcommands.name: where
subcommands.description: Machines and checkouts that contain a commit

subcommands.name: why
subcommands.description: Blame one line plus the session, tracker item, decision and rules recorded when it was committed

subcommands.name: group
subcommands.description: Group a dirty tree into commits by the agent session that wrote each change; --apply commits the groups

subcommands.name: message
subcommands.description: Draft a commit message from the staged diff, the active tracker and its action log

subcommands.name: bisect-agent
subcommands.description: Find the first bad commit with the repository's quality gate as the test

subcommands.name: resolve
subcommands.description: Propose a resolution for each conflicted file from both sides' recorded intent; --apply writes it

subcommands.name: handoff
subcommands.description: Pack a branch, its tracker and related memory into one SSSS bundle for another agent or machine

subcommands.name: worktree-list
subcommands.description: Read registered worktrees for the current repository

subcommands.name: worktree-create
subcommands.description: Create a detached worktree at a specified path and base ref

subcommands.name: worktree-remove
subcommands.description: Remove an owned linked worktree, with explicit force for dirty content

subcommands.name: worktree
subcommands.description: Compatibility form: worktree list, create or remove

subcommands.name: identity
subcommands.description: Show who commits here and which identities the history publishes; exits 1 on a missing or machine-derived identity (--json for machine output)

elements.description: Git Hygiene Repository Hygiene Card Face
